title: Design of lighter than air vehicles for planetary exploration.
author: Bruno Avena de Azevedo
abstract: Lighter-than-air (LTA) vehicles can be used on Earth (for oceanographic and atmospheric studies and other Earth science applications) and also for exploration of other bodies in the Solar System that have an atmosphere. Titan (one of the moons of Saturn and the only moon in the Solar System with a substantial atmosphere), Venus and Mars are of particular interest. This work concentrates on the design and analysis of LTA architectures for a Titan Montgolfičre (hot air balloon) explorer. Conceptual designs of horizontal controllability of the balloon are proposed, analyzed and some tested. An innovative way of converting vertical motion into horizontal motion is introduced and validated by experiments.
